scope: implementation-side gap record; washed design only; no native receipt claim

known_facts.claim: A callback receipt format is clean-room design only; it is not a native-observed schema.
The observed host path closes/destroys an inner object and creates a fresh inner object for a later record; this does not define receipt or restore semantics.
Parent transaction commit/abort execution has not been run.
Encoded-output write observations do not establish parent-state receipt persistence or physical-write rollback semantics.

undefined_contract_items.minimum_closure: Define a typed transition contract, exact owner receipt set, generation/token bindings and canonical receipt representation.
Define invalid-input admission and prove committed state, generation and durable receipt remain unchanged on rejection.

unknowns: which failures retire the callback token
undefined_contract_items.minimum_closure: Define fatal classification, owner retirement set, token invalidation and a no-reuse acceptance vector.
Define destroy/reset/fresh ordering and prove no prior owner/token/receipt is reused.
Define repeat/stale-token outcomes and vectors for active, committed, retired and unknown generations.
Define durable-operation ordering and accurately distinguish partial physical writes from unchanged state.

no_guessing_rules: Do not claim a native receipt format.
Do not treat fresh reconstruction as portable restore.
Do not claim disk state is unchanged after a durable partial write unless the contract proves it.
Do not generate success bytes or digests before the canonical schema is complete.
